title: ENERGY CONSERVATION
officialText:
1011.1 Minimum requirements. Where an existing building or portion thereof is undergoing a
change of occupancy, such change shall be subject to Chapter C5 or R5 of the New York City
Energy Conservation Code, as applicable.
